messages:
Kei: Quick sync: Delta cohort is asking for phased feature gating. They only want rerank in phase 1. Need to confirm enrollment flow changes and feedback plan.
Aria: Enrollment flow change is minor: hide rerank endpoints in the onboarding UI and flag them as coming soon. We should capture that in the enablement doc.
Liam: Feedback plan: phase 1 micro-survey after 24h and a contextual follow-up if rerank is used after phase 2. Also track task completion rate for rerank when enabled.
support-bot: Heads up: beta-support queue created -> #beta-delta-support. Link: https://redwood.app/queues/beta-delta
Kei: Risk: if rerank is delayed, Cedar said they might delay full adoption but still sign pilot. Let's document adoption dependency.
Aria: Also note training slots: two 1hr sessions. One for SREs (focus on latency and fallbacks), one for product (feature behaviors).
Liam: Ops: can you provide an expected p95 impact for toggling rerank off? It reduces token cost but may increase client-side compute on their end.
ops-bot: Estimated: turning off rerank reduces server-side tokens by ~30% and cuts p95 by ~15ms on average.
Kei: Next actions:
- Aria: hide rerank in UI + update enablement doc (due 48h)
- Liam: prepare survey flows and tracking metrics (due 72h)
- Ops: provide exact canary window timings once provisioned
Kei: Good catch. Keep this thread for enrollment changes only.
